concept: SQS FIFO: ordering and exactly-once processing
tests: Choosing a queue that preserves message order and eliminates duplicates.
expected: Amazon SQS FIFO queue: strict ordering within a message group and exactly-once processing (deduplication). Triggers: "exactly in the sequence received", "avoid duplicates".
why_not: SQS Standard is best-effort ordering and at-least-once; SNS standard doesn't guarantee order; Firehose delivers streams to storage.
